## Signature Therapies & Services
- **Full Body Massage:** Comprehensive head-to-toe relaxation restoring muscle vitality, circulation, and mental clarity (60-90 min).
- **Swedish Massage:** Gentle, flowing long strokes to melt physical stress, lower cortisol, and enhance restorative sleep (60-90 min).
- **Deep Tissue Therapy:** Targeted chronic tension release, myofascial trigger point therapy for lower back pain, sciatica, and desk fatigue (60-90 min).
- **Traditional Thai Massage:** Ancient acupressure and assisted stretching to boost joint mobility, flexibility, and energy channels (60-90 min).
- **Aromatherapy Massage:** Premium therapeutic essential oils (lavender, eucalyptus, lemongrass) to calm anxiety and elevate sensory well-being (60-90 min).
- **Hot Stone Therapy:** Heated volcanic basalt stones melting deep muscle tightness and cold-weather fatigue (75-90 min).
- **Romantic Couples Massage:** Private couple's luxury suite with side-by-side treatments, aromatherapy, and candlelight ambiance (90 min).
- **Foot Reflexology:** Targeted pressure point stimulation on soles and calves to stimulate internal organ vitality and relieve walking exhaustion (45-60 min).
- **Skincare & Facials:** HydraFacial, whitening glow facial, deep pore extractions, and herbal body scrubs.

## Quality & Hygiene Standards
- Internationally certified male and female therapists.
- 100% private, sanitized treatment rooms with fresh Egyptian cotton linens for every client.
- Strict client privacy, non-invasive professional draping, and zero tolerance for unprofessional conduct.
- Secure on-site parking near Wallayat Complex and Nando's Phase 7.
